audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart is out of step with the page's own text: it calls Level 3 Fiora, Levels 4-5 'Skill', first item 'Skill' and 2+ items Fiora, while the prose says level 3 is even and everything from level 11 / two items is Kayle's.
audit.why: whys[2] literally says 'call it even here'; whys[4], whys[5] and whys[6] describe Kayle kiting, out-ranging and winning outright once ranged form and two items land.
audit.corrected: win[2]/phases[2] -> Skill; win[3]/phases[3] -> Fiora; win[5], win[6] and phases[5], phases[6] -> Kayle, with ratings dropped to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Divine Judgment is tracked everywhere but its cooldown is never given, so 'bait it' has no value attached.
audit.why: Kayle R is 160/120/80 — baiting it at rank 1 removes her only escape for nearly three minutes. Fiora W is 24s at rank 1, R is 110s.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d and dontsFull[2].d now carry 160s, 24s and 110s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two interactions absent: Starfire Spellblade is an auto-attack reset (the wind-up is the tell, not a cast), and Celestial Blessing heals her every 15s so Grievous Wounds decides extended trades.
audit.why: Riot's text: Starfire Spellblade empowers her NEXT attack; Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal at every rank. Fiora's chip pattern is exactly what that heal answers.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text now names the Starfire wind-up as the step-back cue; dontsFull[0].d and tradeGood now state the 15s heal and the need for anti-heal.

edits.before: Kayle is melee, has no waveclear and no escape — Q a Vital, hold E for the all-in crit, and walk her down every time the side re-marks.
edits.after: Kayle is melee, has no waveclear and no escape — Q a Vital, and her Starfire Spellblade wind-up, not a cast, is your step-back cue.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — 160s at rank 1, so a baited invuln buys you nearly three minutes. - Riposte: 24s at rank 1, save it for her Starfire auto. - Grand Challenge: 110s — kill windows only.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her get-out at 6 — 160s at rank 1. Engage only once it is spent.

edits.before: Kayle wastes Divine Judgment (Invuln) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: Kayle spends Divine Judgment — commit at once, it is down 160s at rank 1.

edits.before: That is Kayle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Her Celestial Blessing heals every 15s — without Grievous Wounds, chip never sticks.

edits.before: Burning Riposte on poke — your W exists to delete his ONE key spell; waste it and the duel maths flips against you.
edits.after: Dumping R into Divine Judgment wastes 110s of Grand Challenge — bait the invuln first, then paint the four vitals.

edits.before: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Kayle, AA once, and E-slow out — repeat until his bar forces the all-in he loses.
edits.after: Q-lunge the exposed vital on Kayle, AA once, and E-slow out — her Celestial Blessing (15s) cannot outheal four marks.
